title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: A buddy for the shy player
hook: Who does your shy player stand next to at practice?
intro: A new player hangs back during drills.
They do not know anyone yet.
statement: One friend can change how a kid feels about the team.
q1: Do you pair them with a friendly teammate —
q2: or let friendships form on their own?
q3: Who on your team is good at including others?
t1: There is no single right way. But shy kids settle in
t2: when someone makes room for them.
ctaLines: Buddy pairs. Rotate partners. Let it happen.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Who does your shy player stand next to at practice?
A new player hangs back during drills. They do not know anyone yet.
One friend can change how a kid feels about the team.
Assign a buddy or let it happen naturally. There is no single right way.
Do you assign buddies? Share your habit in the comments.
